goals.easy:
Goal: Remember the briefly lit forbidden cells. Press and release the arrow buttons to move one cell per press. Reach the ring without entering a forbidden cell or leaving the board. Do not touch the slider.

TASK RECIPE:
A 4 by 4 board with three forbidden cells.

Remember the briefly displayed forbidden cells. Use physical press-and-release cycles on the arrow buttons, one cell per valid cycle. Holding a button does not repeat movement; simultaneous direction presses are invalid. Do not touch, grasp or lift the slider. Its full footprint and swept motion must avoid forbidden cells and the board boundary. Finish with its full footprint inside the ring, release the buttons and let it settle for at least 0.5 seconds. A shortest route is not required.

Scoring (highest eligible stage; stages are not added):
0: Any strict success condition is unmet.
100: Only valid button cycles move the slider; its footprint and swept motion stay legal throughout; it finishes fully inside the ring with buttons released and at least 0.5 seconds of stability.
